note: AStaticMeshCollectionActor::UpdateComponentsInternal(UBOOL) - THE fix for the disjointed map. The cooker merges thousands of StaticMeshActors into collection actors and each merged mesh's world matrix is the CachedParentToWorld (UPrimitiveComponent @336) that Serialize reads after the actor data, not the component's Translation/Rotation/Scale3D, which stay identity. Retail overrides UpdateComponentsInternal to hand each UStaticMeshComponent that matrix (decompile: v8 = v6 + 84 dwords = +336; the ternary against AActor::LocalToWorld() covers non-static-mesh components; bCollisionUpdate ignored and passed on as FALSE). Without the override the base AActor::UpdateComponentsInternal passes the collection's LocalToWorld and ConditionalAttach -> SetParentToWorld overwrites the loaded matrix, collapsing every merged prop onto (0,0,0): 2,915 of 2,926 attached primitives in L_Tower_P, 5,417 of 5,423 in L_Pub_Day_P. Defined in Engine/Src/UnStaticMesh.cpp, declared in Engine/Classes/StaticMeshCollectionActor.uc and Engine/Inc/EngineClasses.h. Carries -disnosmcaxform, which reverts to Super:: so the defect reproduces on a fixed exe. 2012 rva 0x381800, unstaticmesh.cpp:4045

UPrimitiveComponent::SetTransformedToWorld() - checked against retail, no change needed. FScaleRotationTranslationMatrix(Scale * Scale3D, Rotation, Translation) * CachedParentToWorld in that order, AbsoluteTranslation zeroes row 3, AbsoluteScale normalises the three axes, AbsoluteRotation replaces each by its length on its own axis; masks 0x2000000/0x4000000/0x8000000 at @280 agree with the retail SDK. The composition was never the defect, its input was. 2012 rva 0x12ef80

UPrimitiveComponent::SetParentToWorld(const FMatrix&) - checked against retail, no change needed. The whole body is CachedParentToWorld = ParentToWorld, which is why an attach with the wrong parent transform destroys a collection actor's serialized matrices. 2012 rva 0x12e4b0

AActor::UpdateComponentsInternal(UBOOL) - checked against retail, no change needed. Passes LocalToWorld() to every component; correct for every actor except the two collection actors, which override it. 2012 rva 0x185fa0

UActorComponent::ConditionalAttach(FSceneInterface*, AActor*, const FMatrix&) - checked against retail, no change needed. Clears bNeedsReattach|bNeedsUpdateTransform, sets Scene and Owner, calls the virtual SetParentToWorld unconditionally, then Attach() if IsValidComponent(). 2012 rva 0x1838b0

UActorComponent::UpdateComponent(FSceneInterface*, AActor*, const FMatrix&, UBOOL) - checked against retail, no change needed, with one signature note: retail takes a nullable const FMatrix* whose NULL means 'the owner's LocalToWorld, or FMatrix::Identity with no owner'; ours takes a reference and no caller in the tree can pass NULL. 2012 rva 0x183910
UActorComponent::ConditionalUpdateTransform(const FMatrix&) - checked against retail, no change needed. 2012 rva 0x173400

AActor::LocalToWorld() const - the matrix is term for term identical to ours (GMath.TrigFLOAT lookups, DrawScale3D*DrawScale, PrePivot folded into row 3). Retail additionally caches it in CachedLocalToWorld behind an epsilon compare over CachedLocation/CachedRotation/CachedDrawScale3D/CachedPrePivot/CachedDrawScale and returns a reference; we recompute and return by value. Pure speed difference, a worthwhile follow-up. 2012 rva 0x1774d0

AStaticMeshCollectionActor::Serialize(FArchive&) - re-checked against the 2013 decompile while chasing this defect, no change needed. Reads one FMatrix per StaticMeshComponents entry into component+336 (a dummy for NULL entries), then Components = StaticMeshComponents and StaticMeshComponents.Empty(). The matrices it reads are what the missing UpdateComponentsInternal was throwing away. 2012 rva 0x392de0

ULevel::IncrementalUpdateComponents(INT) - checked against retail, no change needed; ClearComponents() + ConditionalUpdateComponents() per actor with the early bail-out on collection actors. 2012 rva 0x276bf0

-displace, the placement census: DishonoredPlacementCensus() in Engine/Src/UnLevel.cpp, called once per frame from UWorld::UpdateLevelStreaming (Engine/Src/UnWorld.cpp). Per level: actor count, actor-location bounding box, primitive count, attached count, the bounding box of the composed LocalToWorld origins, how many sit on their owner's location (collapsed), the same restricted to StaticMeshCollectionActor components, how many carry an all-zero CachedParentToWorld, and how many land outside HALF_WORLD_MAX. Plus a layout line giving the reflected offset of Translation/Rotation/Scale/Scale3D/CachedParentToWorld next to STRUCT_OFFSET (all agree: 400/412/424/428/336), and per-component detail lines on the first pass. Off by default, costs nothing when off

-disnosmcaxform, in AStaticMeshCollectionActor::UpdateComponentsInternal: falls back to Super:: so the defect reproduces on a fixed exe and the before/after pair comes off one build. The regression check to add at merge is the displace world line's collapsed count under -displace: 2,915 with the defect, 405 without, on L_Tower_P
